  WHY: Rename failures can leave a session with an old title that cleanup does not match, and label-read failures can skip archival without reporting.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:12 (new bullet) | severity=low | confidence=[4]

  WHY: Operators cannot distinguish an intentional project-mode skip from cleanup that was silently dropped.
